caption: This is spicy ramen with a rich, deep-red broth, topped with a generous mound of bean sprouts. It sits in a white bowl with red trim, against a dark background, under warm lighting that highlights the broth’s glossy sheen.

segments_info.text: Dark, smooth, flat surface with subtle texture and faint golden patterned edge visible.
The spicy broth is deep reddish-brown, glossy, and thick, swirling around noodles and bean sprouts.
White ceramic bowl with red concentric stripes and red Chinese characters on rim, showing slight residue stains.
A white ceramic spoon with a smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, rounded tip.
